2. **Pillar 02 — Google Maps & AI Discovery (SEO + AEO)**: Google Maps Local 3-Pack rank blueprint, Generative Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and geotagged neighborhood authority.
3. **Pillar 03 — WhatsApp & AI Automations**: Sub-60s automated booking engine, real-time slot confirmations, UPI integration, automated 2-way reminders, and automated 5-star Google review booster.
4. **Pillar 04 — Influencer & Direct Growth Engine**: Turning rented social attention into owned customer equity, creator traffic straight to owned web app, and WhatsApp VIP repeat booking broadcasts at ₹0 ad cost.
